# A reviewer's map of Advisor Pulse

<!-- Generated by scripts/reviewer_map.py from reviewer-skills.json; edit inputs. -->

Skill extraction snapshot: 2026-10-23 (Toronto). 12 owner-supplied roles, 6 AE / adjacent and 6 DE; 8 descriptions retrieved, the remainder retained only as owner summaries. No extractable skill list: J12.

This is a selected historical sample, including expired or inaccessible roles. Counts are lower-bound observed mentions (required or preferred), once per posting and competency; an absent tag means unknown, not an employer rejecting that skill. AE/DE is the owner's classification. These counts do not establish market prevalence, salary, vacancy status, or interview readiness.

Strong means inspectable implementation and tests within this synthetic project. Weak means partial or transferable evidence; missing means no direct implementation. No grade claims employment experience, regulated deployment, adoption, or business impact.
